local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")


local function kickPlayer(targetName, reason)
    local args = {
        [1] = targetName,
        [2] = reason or "No reason provided."
    }
    ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VoteKickInProgress"):WaitForChild("VoteEvent"):FireServer(unpack(args))
end

local function scaleplayer(size)
    local allsizes = size
    for _, part in ipairs({"Depth", "Width", "Height", "Head"}) do
        local args = {[1] = allsizes}
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlayerScale"):WaitForChild(part):FireServer(unpack(args))
        task.wait()
    end
end

local function winVote()
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VoteKickInProgress"):WaitForChild("VoteAdded"):FireServer()
    end
end

local function kickAll(reason)
    local excludeLocalPlayer = {
        [LocalPlayer.Name] = true
    }

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if not excludeLocalPlayer[player.Name] then
            kickPlayer(player.Name, reason)
            for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                task.wait()
                ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VoteKickInProgress"):WaitForChild("VoteAdded"):FireServer()
            end
            task.wait(15.7)
        end
    end
end

local function addHealth(healthInput)
    local timesToFire = math.floor(healthInput / 100)
    for i = 1, timesToFire do
        task.spawn(function()
            ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("MoreHealth"):FireServer()
        end)
    end
end

local function giveAddons()
    local localAddons = LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Spawner.SpawnFrame.Addons
    local RSAddons = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("AddonStorage"):GetChildren()

    for _, addon in ipairs(RSAddons) do
        local clonedAddon = addon:Clone()
        clonedAddon.Parent = localAddons
    end
end

ScreenGui.Name = "TrashAdminUI"

    if not enterPressed then return end

    local message = TextBox.Text
    TextBox.Text = ""

    local command, arg1, arg2 = string.match(message, "(%w+)%s*(%S*)%s*(.*)")

    if command == "kick" and arg1 then
        kickPlayer(arg1, arg2)
        for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            task.wait()
            ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("VoteKickInProgress"):WaitForChild("VoteAdded"):FireServer()
        end

    elseif command == "kickall" then

-- ESP logic
local espEnabled = false
local espObjects = {}

local function createESP(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if not player.Character or not player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
    if espObjects[player] then return end

    local character = player.Character

    -- highlight system or smt
    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
    highlight.Name = "ESPHighlight"
    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    highlight.FillTransparency = 0.5
    highlight.OutlineTransparency = 1
    highlight.Adornee = character
    highlight.Parent = character

    -- billboardgui with name
    local billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    billboard.Name = "ESPName"
    billboard.Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 40)
    billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    billboard.Adornee = character:FindFirstChild("Head") or character:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    billboard.Parent = character

    local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    textLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
    textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
    textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    textLabel.Text = player.Name
    textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
    textLabel.TextScaled = true
    textLabel.Parent = billboard

    espObjects[player] = {highlight, billboard}
end

local function removeESP(player)
    if espObjects[player] then
        for _, obj in pairs(espObjects[player]) do
            if obj and obj.Parent then
                obj:Destroy()
            end
        end
        espObjects[player] = nil
    end
end

local function toggleESP()
    espEnabled = not espEnabled

    if espEnabled then
        espButton.Text = "Enabled!"
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            createESP(player)
            player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
                wait(1)
                createESP(player)
            end)
        end
    else
        espButton.Text = "ESP Off"
        for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            removeESP(player)
        end
    end

    wait(1)
    espButton.Text = espEnabled and "ESP On" or "ESP Enable"
end

local function TCVRG_fake_script() -- BotGui.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', BotGui)

	-- Made by Real_IceyDev (@lceyDex) --
	-- Simple UI dragger (PC Only/Any device that has a mouse) --
	
	local UIS = game:GetService('UserInputService')
	local frame = script.Parent
	local dragToggle = nil
	local dragSpeed = 0.25
	local dragStart = nil
	local startPos = nil
	
	local function updateInput(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		game:GetService('TweenService'):Create(frame, TweenInfo.new(dragSpeed), {Position = position}):Play()
	end
	
	frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then 
			dragToggle = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = frame.Position
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragToggle = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if dragToggle then
				updateInput(input)
			end
		end
	end)

local function retrySingleAsset(errRecord: FailedRecord, actionBtn: TextButton?, cardFrame: Frame?)
	if actionBtn then
		actionBtn.Text = "..."
		actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.TextMuted
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		local startTime = os.clock()
		local targetToLoad: {any} = {}

		if errRecord.targetInstance and errRecord.targetInstance.Parent then
			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.targetInstance)
		elseif errRecord.contentId ~= "" then
			table.insert(targetToLoad, errRecord.contentId)
		end

		local retrySucceeded = false
		local latestStatus = "Unknown"

		if #targetToLoad > 0 then
			ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(targetToLoad, function(loadedId, status)
				if loadedId == errRecord.contentId or errRecord.contentId == "" then
					latestStatus = tostring(status)
					if status == Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
						retrySucceeded = true
					end
				end
			end)
		else
			latestStatus = "Instance destroyed"
		end

		local elapsedMs = math.floor((os.clock() - startTime) * 1000)

		if retrySucceeded then
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = string.format("OK %dms", elapsedMs)
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Success
			end
			if cardFrame then
				cardFrame.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.SuccessBg
				local s = cardFrame:FindFirstChildOfClass("UIStroke")
				if s then
					s.Color = THEME.Success
				end
			end

			task.delay(1.2, function()
				for i, item in ipairs(state.failed) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(state.failed, i)
						break
					end
				end
				for i, item in ipairs(filteredErrors) do
					if item == errRecord or item.id == errRecord.id then
						table.remove(filteredErrors, i)
						break
					end
				end
				state.failedSeen[errRecord.id] = nil
				state.recoveredCount += 1
				updateUI()

				if state.activeTab == "errors" then
					if cardFrame and cardFrame.Parent then
						cardFrame:Destroy()
					end
					if #filteredErrors == 0 then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				elseif state.activeTab == "info" then
					switchTab("errors")
				end
			end)
		else
			errRecord.retries += 1
			errRecord.reason = string.format("%s (attempt %d)", latestStatus, errRecord.retries + 1)
			if actionBtn then
				actionBtn.Text = "Fail"
				actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Danger
				task.delay(1.4, function()
					actionBtn.Text = "Retry"
					actionBtn.TextColor3 = THEME.Accent
				end)
			end
			if state.activeTab == "info" and currentRecord == errRecord then
				DiagStatus.Text = errRecord.reason
			end
			updateUI()
		end
	end)
end

local function renderNextErrorChunk()
	if renderedErrorCount >= #filteredErrors then
		if loadMoreBtn then
			loadMoreBtn:Destroy()
			loadMoreBtn = nil
		end
		return
	end

	local nextLimit = math.min(#filteredErrors, renderedErrorCount + CONFIG.ErrorPageSize)
	for idx = renderedErrorCount + 1, nextLimit do
		createErrorCard(filteredErrors[idx], idx)
	end
	renderedErrorCount = nextLimit

	local remaining = #filteredErrors - renderedErrorCount
	if remaining > 0 then
		if not loadMoreBtn then
			local btn = create("TextButton", {
				Name = "LoadMoreBtn",
				LayoutOrder = 999999,
				Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
				BackgroundColor3 = THEME.BgCard,
				BorderSizePixel = 0,
				TextColor3 = THEME.Accent,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				TextSize = 10,
				Parent = ErrorScroll,
			})
			corner(btn, 5)
			stroke(btn, THEME.Border)
			btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(renderNextErrorChunk)
			loadMoreBtn = btn
		end
		if loadMoreBtn then
			loadMoreBtn.Text = string.format("Show more (%d remaining)", remaining)
		end
	elseif loadMoreBtn then
		loadMoreBtn:Destroy()
		loadMoreBtn = nil
	end
end

		local totalHeight = ErrorScroll.AbsoluteCanvasSize.Y

renderErrors = function(query: string?)
	loadMoreBtn = nil
	for _, item in ipairs(ErrorScroll:GetChildren()) do
		if item:IsA("Frame") or item:IsA("TextLabel") or item:IsA("TextButton") then
			item:Destroy()
		end
	end

	table.clear(filteredErrors)
	renderedErrorCount = 0

	local q = string.lower(query or "")
	for _, err in ipairs(state.failed) do
		local matches = (q == "")
			or string.find(string.lower(err.name), q, 1, true)
			or string.find(string.lower(err.reason), q, 1, true)
			or string.find(string.lower(err.fullName), q, 1, true)
			or string.find(string.lower(err.contentId), q, 1, true)

		if matches then
			table.insert(filteredErrors, err)
		end
	end

	if #filteredErrors == 0 then
		create("TextLabel", {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextColor3 = THEME.TextDim,
			Text = (q == "") and "No errors recorded." or "No assets match search.",
			Parent = ErrorScroll,
		})
		return
	end

	ErrorScroll.CanvasPosition = Vector2.zero
	renderNextErrorChunk()
end

bind(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input: InputObject)
	if isDragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		RootFrame.Position = UDim2.new(frameStart.X.Scale, frameStart.X.Offset + delta.X, frameStart.Y.Scale, frameStart.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	elseif isResizing and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local deltaX = input.Position.X - resizeStart.X
		local deltaY = input.Position.Y - resizeStart.Y
		local newW = math.clamp(startSize.X + deltaX, CONFIG.MinWidth, CONFIG.MaxWidth)
		local newH = math.clamp(startSize.Y + deltaY, CONFIG.MinHeight, CONFIG.MaxHeight)
		RootFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, newW, 0, newH)
	end
end)

		local fps = math.floor(frameCount / dt)
		frameCount = 0
		lastSample = now

		ChipFps.Text = string.format("FPS %d", fps)

		end)

			ChipTime.Text = formatClock(state.elapsedTime)

			state.speed = speed
			ChipSpeed.Text = string.format("%.0f/s", speed)

			local remain = math.max(0, state.totalInstances - state.processedInstances)
			local eta = (speed > 0) and math.ceil(remain / speed) or 0
			ChipEta.Text = (eta > 0 and eta < 999) and string.format("ETA %ds", eta) or "ETA --"
		end
	end
end)

-- O(1) Pointer Queue + Concurrent Worker Pool
local assetQueue: {Instance} = {}
local queueHead = 1
local queueTail = 0

local function processBatch(batch: {Instance})
	if #batch == 0 then return end
	local leader = batch[1]
	if leader and leader.Parent then
		CurrentPath.Text = formatPath(leader)
		CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
			"Class: %s | Workers: %d/%d | Files: %d",
			getAssetType(leader),
			state.activeWorkers,
			CONFIG.MaxWorkers,
			state.totalFiles
		)
	end

	local uriToInstance: {[string]: Instance} = {}
	for _, inst in ipairs(batch) do
		for _, uri in ipairs(extractContentIds(inst)) do
			if not uriToInstance[uri] then
				uriToInstance[uri] = inst
			end
		end
	end

	ContentProvider:PreloadAsync(batch, function(contentId, fetchStatus)
		state.totalFiles += 1
		if fetchStatus ~= Enum.AssetFetchStatus.Success then
			local idKey = tostring(contentId)
			if not state.failedSeen[idKey] then
				state.failedSeen[idKey] = true
				local finalInst = uriToInstance[idKey] or leader

				table.insert(state.failed, {
					id = idKey,
					name = finalInst and finalInst.Name or idKey,
					fullName = finalInst and finalInst:GetFullName() or idKey,
					assetType = finalInst and getAssetType(finalInst) or "Asset",
					contentId = idKey,
					targetInstance = finalInst,
					reason = tostring(fetchStatus),
					retries = 0,
				})
			end
		end
	end)

	state.processedInstances += #batch
	updateUI()
end

local function spawnWorkers()
	if not state.isRunning and queueHead <= queueTail then
		state.isRunning = true
		state.activeStartTime = os.clock()
	end

	while state.activeWorkers < CONFIG.MaxWorkers and queueHead <= queueTail do
		state.activeWorkers += 1

		task.spawn(function()
			while queueHead <= queueTail do
				local batch: {Instance} = {}
				local count = math.min(CONFIG.BatchSize, queueTail - queueHead + 1)
				for _ = 1, count do
					local item = assetQueue[queueHead]
					assetQueue[queueHead] = nil :: any
					queueHead += 1
					if item then
						table.insert(batch, item)
					end
				end

				if #batch > 0 then
					processBatch(batch)
				end
				task.wait()
			end

			state.activeWorkers -= 1

			if state.activeWorkers == 0 and queueHead > queueTail then
				queueHead = 1
				queueTail = 0

				if state.processedInstances >= state.totalInstances and not state.isComplete then
					state.accumulatedTime += (os.clock() - state.activeStartTime)
					state.elapsedTime = state.accumulatedTime
					state.isComplete = true
					state.isRunning = false

					StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = (#state.failed > 0) and THEME.Danger or THEME.Success
					CurrentPath.Text = "ALL ASSETS VERIFIED"
					CurrentMeta.Text = string.format(
						"Done in %s (%d files, %d failed)",
						formatClock(state.elapsedTime),
						state.totalFiles,
						#state.failed
					)
					ChipEta.Text = "DONE"
					updateUI()
					if state.activeTab == "errors" then
						renderErrors(SearchInput.Text)
					end
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function enqueue(items: {Instance})
	if queueHead > queueTail then
		queueHead = 1
		queueTail = 0
	end

	local added = 0
	for _, item in ipairs(items) do
		if not seenInstances[item] then
			seenInstances[item] = true
			if #extractContentIds(item) > 0 then
				queueTail += 1
				assetQueue[queueTail] = item
				added += 1
			end
		end
	end

	if added > 0 then
		state.totalInstances += added
		state.isComplete = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Accent
		updateUI()
		spawnWorkers()
	end
end

local pendingStream: {Instance} = {}
local streamDebounce: thread? = nil

local function onDescendant(inst: Instance)
	if isTrackable(inst) then
		table.insert(pendingStream, inst)
		if not streamDebounce then
			streamDebounce = task.delay(1.2, function()
				local toAdd = pendingStream
				pendingStream = {}
				streamDebounce = nil
				enqueue(toAdd)
			end)
		end
	end
end

bind(workspace.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
bind(ReplicatedStorage.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)

local pGui = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") or LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
if pGui then
	bind(pGui.DescendantAdded, onDescendant)
end

local function bootstrap()
	CurrentPath.Text = "INDEXING DOMAIN ROOTS..."

	local roots: {Instance?} = {
		workspace, ReplicatedStorage, ReplicatedFirst, Lighting,
		MaterialService, SoundService, StarterPack, pGui
	}

	local found: {Instance} = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(roots) do
		if r then
			for _, d in ipairs(r:GetDescendants()) do
				if isTrackable(d) then
					table.insert(found, d)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	enqueue(found)

	if state.totalInstances == 0 then
		state.isComplete = true
		state.isRunning = false
		StatusDot.BackgroundColor3 = THEME.Success
		CurrentPath.Text = "NO ASSETS TO LOAD"
		CurrentMeta.Text = "0 items in memory"
		updateUI()
	end
end

bootstrap()
